name: EPIC 250019361
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 10.5 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 250019361 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.485177 (16th-84th percentiles 10.058864-11.04707), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 1,678 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.93 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,578 K at its surface.
